// SwitchesPT reports whether an ODD number of Layer 7e switch effects apply
// to the card (Rule 613.4e / 701.10): each switch swaps the pair, so two
// simultaneous switches cancel out and the card reads unswitched. Scoped
// through the same effectAffectsCard matcher every other apply path uses, so
// AffectsSpecific / auras / conditional gating all behave identically — an
// effect whose ConditionFn goes false (or that is removed at end of turn)
// simply stops counting, restoring the unswitched values.
func (m *EffectManager) SwitchesPT(card *Card, sourceControllerIdx int) bool {
	m.mu.RLock()
	defer m.mu.RUnlock()

	count := 0
	for _, e := range m.effects {
		if e.SwitchPT && m.effectAffectsCard(e, card, sourceControllerIdx) {
			count++
		}
	}
	return count%2 == 1
}

// GetPowerWithEffects returns effective power including all continuous effects
// Layer order: 7b (set P/T), 7c (+N/+N effects), 7d (counters)
func (c *Card) GetPowerWithEffects(em *EffectManager) int {
	// Animated non-creatures (manlands) have nil BasePower but obtain a set
	// power via a ContinuousEffect. Skip the nil-guard so Layer 7b applies.
	if c.BasePower == nil && !c.AnimatedAsCreature {
		return 0
	}

	base := 0
	if c.BasePower != nil {
		base = *c.BasePower
	}

	if em == nil {
		return base + c.Counters.GetPowerModifier()
	}

	// Check if any effect sets power to a specific value (Layer 7b)
	if setPower := em.GetSetPower(c, c.Controller); setPower != nil {
		return *setPower + em.GetPowerBonus(c, c.Controller) + c.Counters.GetPowerModifier()
	}
	// Normal case: base + bonuses (Layer 7c)
	return base + em.GetPowerBonus(c, c.Controller) + c.Counters.GetPowerModifier()
}

// GetToughnessWithEffects returns effective toughness including all continuous effects
// Layer order: 7b (set P/T), 7c (+N/+N effects), 7d (counters)
func (c *Card) GetToughnessWithEffects(em *EffectManager) int {
	// Animated non-creatures (manlands) have nil BaseToughness but obtain a
	// set toughness via a ContinuousEffect. Skip the nil-guard so Layer 7b applies.
	if c.BaseToughness == nil && !c.AnimatedAsCreature {
		return 0
	}

	base := 0
	if c.BaseToughness != nil {
		base = *c.BaseToughness
	}

	if em == nil {
		return base + c.Counters.GetToughnessModifier()
	}

	// Check if any effect sets toughness to a specific value (Layer 7b)
	if setToughness := em.GetSetToughness(c, c.Controller); setToughness != nil {
		return *setToughness + em.GetToughnessBonus(c, c.Controller) + c.Counters.GetToughnessModifier()
	}
	// Normal case: base + bonuses (Layer 7c)
	return base + em.GetToughnessBonus(c, c.Controller) + c.Counters.GetToughnessModifier()
}

// ptBeforeSwitch computes the (power, toughness) pair through Layer 7b (set
// P/T), 7c (+N/+N) and 7d (counters) — i.e. everything BEFORE a Layer 7e
// switch. Both public getters share it so they can never disagree, and it
// never calls either of them, so the 7e swap below needs no recursion.
func (c *Card) ptBeforeSwitch(em *EffectManager) (int, int) {
	power, toughness := 0, 0
	if c.BasePower != nil {
		power = *c.BasePower
	}
	if c.BaseToughness != nil {
		toughness = *c.BaseToughness
	}

	if em == nil {
		return power + c.Counters.GetPowerModifier(), toughness + c.Counters.GetToughnessModifier()
	}

	// Layer 7b: effects that set P/T to specific values
	if setPower := em.GetSetPower(c, c.Controller); setPower != nil {
		power = *setPower
	}
	if setToughness := em.GetSetToughness(c, c.Controller); setToughness != nil {
		toughness = *setToughness
	}
	// Layer 7c (bonuses) + Layer 7d (counters)
	power += em.GetPowerBonus(c, c.Controller) + c.Counters.GetPowerModifier()
	toughness += em.GetToughnessBonus(c, c.Controller) + c.Counters.GetToughnessModifier()
	return power, toughness
}

// GetPTWithEffects returns the single post-layer (power, toughness) pair:
// 7b/7c/7d as computed by ptBeforeSwitch, then the Layer 7e switch applied
// last (Rule 613.4e). A 2/5 with +1/+2 and a switch reads 7/3, not 8/5 —
// the switch swaps the FINAL pair, it does not snapshot into Layer 7b.
func (c *Card) GetPTWithEffects(em *EffectManager) (int, int) {
	power, toughness := c.ptBeforeSwitch(em)
	if em != nil && em.SwitchesPT(c, c.Controller) {
		power, toughness = toughness, power
	}
	return power, toughness
}

// GetPowerWithEffects returns effective power including all continuous effects
// Layer order: 7b (set P/T), 7c (+N/+N effects), 7d (counters), 7e (switch P/T)
func (c *Card) GetPowerWithEffects(em *EffectManager) int {
	// Animated non-creatures (manlands) have nil BasePower but obtain a set
	// power via a ContinuousEffect. Skip the nil-guard so Layer 7b applies.
	if c.BasePower == nil && !c.AnimatedAsCreature {
		return 0
	}
	power, _ := c.GetPTWithEffects(em)
	return power
}

// GetToughnessWithEffects returns effective toughness including all continuous effects
// Layer order: 7b (set P/T), 7c (+N/+N effects), 7d (counters), 7e (switch P/T)
func (c *Card) GetToughnessWithEffects(em *EffectManager) int {
	// Animated non-creatures (manlands) have nil BaseToughness but obtain a
	// set toughness via a ContinuousEffect. Skip the nil-guard so Layer 7b applies.
	if c.BaseToughness == nil && !c.AnimatedAsCreature {
		return 0
	}
	_, toughness := c.GetPTWithEffects(em)
	return toughness
}

package game

// ticket:engine.pt-switch-layer/v1 — Layer 7e "switch power and toughness"
// behavior tests. The failure this guards against: representing a switch by
// snapshotting the current P/T into SetPower/SetToughness (Layer 7b), which
// makes a 2/5 with +1/+2 read 8/5 instead of the correct 7/3. The switch must
// be applied to the pair that already went through 7b, 7c and 7d.

import "testing"

func switchPTCreature(gs *GameState, name string, power, toughness int) *Card {
	c := NewCreature(name, ManaCost{}, power, toughness, 1)
	c.Owner, c.Controller = 0, 0
	gs.Battlefield.AddCard(c)
	return c
}

// 2/5 + (+1/+2) + a +1/+1 counter, then switch: the switch swaps the
// post-7d pair, and turning the effect off restores the unswitched values.
func TestSwitchPTAppliesAfterAdditiveLayers(t *testing.T) {
	gs := NewGame("P0", "P1", false)
	ox := switchPTCreature(gs, "Switch Test Ox", 2, 5)

	// Layer 7c pump: 2/5 -> 3/7.
	gs.EffectManager.Register(&ContinuousEffect{
		AffectsSpecific: ox.ID,
		PowerMod:        1,
		ToughnessMod:    2,
	})
	if p, tg := ox.GetPowerWithEffects(gs.EffectManager), ox.GetToughnessWithEffects(gs.EffectManager); p != 3 || tg != 7 {
		t.Fatalf("pre-switch P/T = %d/%d, want 3/7", p, tg)
	}

	active := true
	sw := &ContinuousEffect{
		AffectsSpecific: ox.ID,
		SwitchPT:        true,
		ConditionFn:     func() bool { return active },
	}
	gs.EffectManager.Register(sw)
	if sw.Layer != "7e" {
		t.Fatalf("default layer for a switch effect = %q, want %q", sw.Layer, "7e")
	}

	// Post-additive switch: 3/7 -> 7/3 (a 7b snapshot would give 8/5).
	if p, tg := ox.GetPowerWithEffects(gs.EffectManager), ox.GetToughnessWithEffects(gs.EffectManager); p != 7 || tg != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("switched P/T = %d/%d, want 7/3", p, tg)
	}
	// Both getters must agree with the shared pair.
	pp, tt := ox.GetPTWithEffects(gs.EffectManager)
	if pp != ox.GetPowerWithEffects(gs.EffectManager) || tt != ox.GetToughnessWithEffects(gs.EffectManager) {
		t.Fatalf("getters disagree with GetPTWithEffects: pair %d/%d vs %d/%d",
			pp, tt, ox.GetPowerWithEffects(gs.EffectManager), ox.GetToughnessWithEffects(gs.EffectManager))
	}

	// Layer 7d counters are included before the switch: 4/8 -> 8/4.
	gs.AddCounters(ox, CounterPlusOnePlusOne, 1)
	if p, tg := ox.GetPowerWithEffects(gs.EffectManager), ox.GetToughnessWithEffects(gs.EffectManager); p != 8 || tg != 4 {
		t.Fatalf("switched P/T with a +1/+1 counter = %d/%d, want 8/4", p, tg)
	}

	// Removal / UntilEOT cleanup (modelled here via the shared
	// effect-affects-card gate) restores the unswitched values.
	active = false
	if p, tg := ox.GetPowerWithEffects(gs.EffectManager), ox.GetToughnessWithEffects(gs.EffectManager); p != 4 || tg != 8 {
		t.Fatalf("after the switch stopped applying, P/T = %d/%d, want 4/8", p, tg)
	}
}

// Two simultaneous switches cancel; an unrelated creature is untouched, and a
// plain pump with no switch registered is behaviorally unchanged.
func TestSwitchPTTwoSwitchesCancelAndScope(t *testing.T) {
	gs := NewGame("P0", "P1", false)
	ox := switchPTCreature(gs, "Switch Cancel Ox", 2, 5)
	bystander := switchPTCreature(gs, "Switch Bystander Bear", 4, 1)

	gs.EffectManager.Register(&ContinuousEffect{
		AffectsSpecific: ox.ID,
		PowerMod:        1,
		ToughnessMod:    2,
	})
	gs.EffectManager.Register(&ContinuousEffect{AffectsSpecific: ox.ID, SwitchPT: true})
	gs.EffectManager.Register(&ContinuousEffect{AffectsSpecific: ox.ID, SwitchPT: true})

	if p, tg := ox.GetPowerWithEffects(gs.EffectManager), ox.GetToughnessWithEffects(gs.EffectManager); p != 3 || tg != 7 {
		t.Fatalf("two switches should cancel: P/T = %d/%d, want 3/7", p, tg)
	}
	if p, tg := bystander.GetPowerWithEffects(gs.EffectManager), bystander.GetToughnessWithEffects(gs.EffectManager); p != 4 || tg != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("unaffected creature P/T = %d/%d, want 4/1", p, tg)
	}
}
>>>END
EXPECT: A ContinuousEffect with SwitchPT:true now defaults to Layer 7e and makes both P/T getters return the same pair with power/toughness swapped after 7b/7c/7d (2/5 with +1/+2 reads 7/3), with two such effects cancelling and removal restoring the unswitched values.
